source: Existing OpenStreetMap city snapshot; preserve original references and tags

heightEstimation.method: Median of nearby same-use source heights; no iterative reuse of estimates
heightEstimation.unsupported: Retain existing fallback and explicitly record insufficient evidence

limitations: OSM outlines and tags are volunteered mapping, not a cadastral survey
Nearby-height estimates remain estimates, even when the neighbours have explicit height tags
Unknown building uses are not silently assigned a residential or commercial type
Display height exaggeration is applied later and is not included in source heights
